name: Pölchow (Germany)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pölchow (a yellow flank with bars and a yellow griffin on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Pölchow; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Pölchow arms — flank and griffin on blue
